name: Truck Racing
summary:
Think you know racing? Try doing it in a 5-ton beast!

Truck Racing offers a unique twist on the motorsport genre. Leave the trailers and speed limits behind. In this game, you take control of powerful semi-truck cabs (bobtails) and push them to their absolute limits on professional race tracks.

Drifting a sports car is one thing, but sliding a massive truck through a hairpin turn requires a whole new level of skill. Feel the weight, hear the roar of the diesel engines, and battle for the first place again
